closeout.finalDecision: Accept measured initialization cost; retain fresh apps; implement neither an app pool nor Monkey dispatch-list optimization.
closeout.removed: Runtime timing, runtime switch, dedicated tests, benchmark driver and public guide.
closeout.reproduction: Requires removed uncommitted measurement implementation and compatible artifacts; recorded HEAD alone is insufficient. No complete replay archive is retained.
closeout.supersedes: The decision.recommendedCandidate field records the earlier candidate, not current follow-up work.
closeout.measurementPayload: Original measurements and provenance hashes retained unchanged. They do not describe rebuilt post-cleanup artifacts.

question: Attribute fresh SSR app initialization owners without implementing optimization or app reuse.

cpuSampling.method: Node --cpu-prof, target interval 500 microseconds; profiles cover startup and workload; only aggregate built-handler frames retained.

interpretation.firstObserved: Not proof of process-cold startup; target process freshness is external evidence.
interpretation.serverTiming: Inclusive nested spans, not additive; no derived pure-render or API-wait estimate.
interpretation.total: ssr_total excludes earlier Vona/Sys preparation and HTTP transmission.
interpretation.percentiles: p50 is median; p95 is nearest rank. Warmup and first observed are excluded from measured phases.

limits: CPU sample weights cover process startup and all workload phases, not isolated warm per-hook wall time.
Inclusive rows overlap and must not be added.
Only top 100 inclusive built-handler frames per relevant profile retained; raw profiles remain disposable managed resources.
Sampling adds overhead; baseline timing from the unprofiled run remains the comparison reference.
runtimeLine/runtimeColumn identify runtime-transformed code, not on-disk artifact coordinates; no reliable source-map attribution was established.
cpuSampling.cleanup: managed process and raw-profile resources cleaned

wallAttribution.method: Transient asynchronous Node load hook injects wrappers after shared Sys initialization. sysApplicationInitialize attaches per-app wrappers to AppModule and actual Main/Monkey methods. App close flushes request totals; process exit emits aggregate rows. No source or artifact edits.
wallAttribution.measurementWindow: One first-observed and 30 warmup requests excluded; app indices 32 through 131 correspond to 100 serial requests; final single request excluded.
wallAttribution.aggregation: Sum durations per label within each app, then median/p95/mean across the 100 apps; calls is the aggregate invocation count across those apps, not per-app count.

interpretation.firstObserved: Not proof of process-cold startup; target process freshness is external evidence.
interpretation.serverTiming: Inclusive nested spans, not additive; no derived pure-render or API-wait estimate.
interpretation.total: ssr_total excludes earlier Vona/Sys preparation and HTTP transmission.
interpretation.percentiles: p50 is median; p95 is nearest rank. Warmup and first observed are excluded from measured phases.

cleanup.method: transient Node load hook; no source or artifact edits; per-hook async wrappers add overhead

limits: Async wrappers and clocks add overhead and microtask scheduling; diagnostic timings are not the unprofiled baseline and are not measured optimization gains.
Inclusive recursion and parallel Promise.all paths overlap; label totals can exceed their containing phase wall time and must not be added.
The phase variable is per-app, not async-local. Nested concurrent work can restore labels at different times; phase labels are approximate attribution, not exact critical-path partitions.
setup is the default label outside the explicitly wrapped phases, including post-initialization render work. setup dispatch totals are not ssr_init_setup.
A new module instance is wrapped after _installInner returns; its first moduleLoading invocation can be missed.
No individual bean-constructor or dispatch-exclusive cost was measured. Dispatch duration includes actual hooks and nested bean work.
Registry count queried at process exit was absent after disposal; no runtime module-count claim is supported.
All emitted owner rows retained; no wall-owner top-N truncation.

failedAttempt.failure: ERR_INVALID_RETURN_PROPERTY_VALUE: load hook received null source before server readiness
failedAttempt.resources: Retained according to managed failed-run policy; no manual deletion or reset performed.
failedAttempt.resolution: Asynchronous register load hook awaited next loader; subsequent managed run succeeded.

decision.recommendedCandidate: Preserve fresh apps and hook semantics; test a narrow Sys-registry-scoped ordered monkey-capability dispatch list, retaining per-app instance lookup, current hook lookup, forward/reverse order, targeted Main and AppMonkey behavior, and registry invalidation.

privacy: Aggregate timings, fixed module/hook labels, repository-relative source/artifact paths and hashes only. No raw CPU profiles, HTML, cookies, credentials, target origin, transient port or environment snapshots.
